name: Sellergoo
description:
Sellergoo is a profit-and-operations analytics service for e-commerce sellers. Sellers connect the marketplaces, shops, payment providers, accounting and carrier accounts they already use, and Sellergoo computes what they actually earned after fees, refunds, cost of goods, advertising and overhead — per channel, per product, per order.

This connector gives an AI read-only access to that computed picture for the seller's own workspace: profit KPIs, month-by-month P&L, orders with per-order economics, per-SKU margin, marketplace payouts, stock levels and alerts. It cannot change, create or delete anything, in Sellergoo or in any connected marketplace.

_published_faq.name: How do I add Sellergoo to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor?

acceptedAnswer.text: Add Sellergoo to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor by connecting its remote MCP URL in each client's MCP settings. In Claude, add a custom connector. In ChatGPT, add an MCP app. In Cursor, add an MCP server under Settings. The MCP URL is https://sellergoo.com/api/mcp. This server requires OAuth, so complete the login prompt after you connect.

_published_faq.name: What tools does the Sellergoo MCP server provide?

acceptedAnswer.text: Sellergoo provides these MCP tools: get_inventory, get_kpis, get_me, get_payouts, get_pnl, list_alerts, list_channels, list_orders, and list_products.

_published_faq.name: What are the best alternatives to Sellergoo?

acceptedAnswer.text: As of October 18, 2026, alternatives to Sellergoo in sales-and-marketing on the Manufact MCP catalog include Griddo AX Docs, Rocket Sloth, Affonso.io, Datacircle, and Tolt.
Sellergoo requires authentication. Connect it in Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor and complete the OAuth login prompt.
Sellergoo is developed by Hüseyin Kurtoglu. It is listed as community on the Claude connector directory.
